notes: Whole source dimensions: 2371 x 1689. Landscape halves: a 1245 x 1689; b 1246 x 1689. Whole, a and b each viewed once, followed by the 29 listed local crops, each once. No OCR, text layer, web research, compilation, other page, other reader output or subagent was used.

The supplied H_drawing.tex was read before the parent corrected its association. Its own archive-page/PDF-page metadata identifies another scan; it was explicitly rejected and excluded from this page collation and inventory. No comparison against its x-loop was made as scan-005 evidence.

Observation only: the page has a free-abelian-looking chain, an unfinished-looking boundary difference, three labelled levels of conditions, and a right-column condition C_i with prescribed boundaries. It carries annotations of injectivity/surjectivity for pi_0, pi_1 and pi_2. These descriptions do not certify the statements.
The author explicitly writes: "(NB on n'exige pas que ... (u)=u')". The function letter in that parenthesis remains f|g. No explicit verbal mathematical doubt was otherwise found.

Literal anomalies were retained: first s_i(u) beside s_1(v), unmatched small argument parentheses in the upper difference, and the f|1-shaped index of the pi annotation at c. No mathematical correction was made.
No manuscript folio, date or title was identified. The low left 4 is treated as the archive sheet number and appears only as a comment in reading.tex.

Pale aligned background impressions are visible. The single selected background crop was rotated 90 degrees and autocontrasted, but yielded no securely readable word; it was not flipped or recognized. It does not establish readable typed matter or a word count. The foreground sheet is classified text rather than asserting reused_typed from H editorial prose alone.

Own execution limitations: the background orientation chosen for the one allowed crop did not make the faint impression fully interpretable. This is recorded without pretending to have read it or making a second crop. Some tall local crops are larger than ideal, but all image results were delivered visibly and no result needed a retry.

diff_C=false is used for a C uncertainty resolved to its existing leading reading without changing the content; every such doubt still has its own evidence entry. Changes of leading reading, surviving candidate set, alphabet, layout or graphic geometry have diff_C=true.
No mathematical check event was performed. Reading symbols and recognizing familiar condition shapes were not counted as proof checks; checks is empty.

Plain forms and partial upper returns are kept occurrence-specific; array F_1 and live c F_1 remain F|mathbb F.

notation.evidence: First u has i|1 in place; later u-prime, v and v-prime carry the same unresolved low hooked-upright ambiguity. A high prime is not used as evidence for an i-dot.
Forked upper branches and long hanging tail favour y; tight returns in other occurrences permit f. First occurrence marked y|f, then y used on the page.
Only an r-like rise and p-like bowl/descender are separately visible. No period and no isolated e/s.
The signs below u-prime and w-prime/w have a curved cap with central descending stroke and F below. They are retained as membership turned 90 degrees, not down-arrows.

Explicit right-facing branches occur in a), the b input map, the b-prime final arrow, c input map, c-prime witness map and the upper u/v sketch. Several other short connections end bluntly and remain dashes.
inj has an i-dot and final long j; surj has a low connected middle and long final j. Underlining is separate from the j descenders. No abbreviation is expanded.

Arc endpoints remain separated, lower-right return is drawn, vertical down-arrow passes between w and prime, and three detached dots are preserved. These are graphic observations without mathematical interpretation.

brief_feedback: The supplied H_drawing.tex association required a parent correction; its internal page metadata was sufficient to reject it. The instructions cover the main task well, but a future brief could specify how to log a single permitted background crop when its type orientation remains unclear without allowing a second view. The F-alphabet requirement was valuable: several C=H plain-F agreements concealed long doubled stems.
